title: Chrome embedding: mountSurface options (stage B) and the whoami object (both stages)
description: The data half of the options the hub shell passes to mountSurface(el, options) (08 C-08.16). The one callback (onSignal, the shell's listener for the module's signals) and the optional slots ({chat?, queue?}, elements the module renders its chat panel and queue rail into) are not data and are described in the contract. $defs/whoami is also the body of stage A's whoami message (08-frame-message.json $defs/whoami), so the frame and the module take the same object: who is looking, as the hub knows it, never an access decision in the browser (C-08.9, C-08.19).

label.description: The chat label, the id without its prefix, as the chat-<label> origins carry it.

base.description: The surface API base every module request is made against (C-08.18): in the MVP shape the surface endpoint https://chat-<label>.<hub> (02 keeps it when the surface is hosted). No trailing slash. public/app/http.js request(method, path, opts) prefixes it to every root-absolute path.

ws_url.description: The surface socket (public/app/ws.js wsUrl, which today derives it from location).

answer_origin.description: Where the answer and control frames load from (C-08.21): the chat's answer origin for a viewer the hub admits there (04 C-04.9: steer or Write page), null for one it does not; null keeps asks on the read-only card and Stop without a control frame, as public/app/asks.js does today without an answer origin.

storage_ns.description: The prefix public/app/storage.js puts before every key (C-08.20): `<user>:<chat>`, one user under R16 but the shape kept for a hosted surface.

theme.description: The shell layer at mount, as setTheme takes it later (C-08.22); the same shape as the stage A theme message's body.

mode.description: The mode at mount; the shell's toggle calls setTheme({mode}) later. Default light.

hotkeys.description: The chords the shell reserves (C-08.23); the module binds none and reports a press as a `key` signal.

reserved.description: Spelt as public/app/hotkeys.js chordOf spells them, on lib/core/toolbar-record.js validChord's grammar with an optional Mod+ (08-frame-message.json hotkeys).

device.description: What the shell knows of the screen, for the answer frames' device claim (asks.js deviceKind). The module still decides its own phone posture by shape (public/app/viewport.js).

compat.description: The window the hub configured for the surface this module may connect to (C-08.30; the shape of 12 C-12.10's window): the oldest and newest surface web-chat package versions, inclusive, compared with compareVersions, and the surface protocol range. The module reads GET /api/health package_version and surface_protocol (absent means 1) before it opens a socket and refuses to connect outside the window, reporting conn: refused with versions.surface and versions.surface_protocol set.

min.description: The oldest surface web-chat the module connects to.

max.description: The newest surface web-chat the module was tested against.

surface_protocol.description: The surface protocol versions the module speaks (lib/core/versions.js SURFACE_PROTOCOL_VERSION, health surface_protocol), inclusive at both ends: an integer counter independent of the package version, as 12-compat.json protocol_range is for 05's connector protocol.

surface_hint.description: Optional: the daemon's package_version the hub knows from the connector (12 daemon_versions), for the shell's wording before health answers. The module decides from health, never from this.

whoami.description: Who is looking, as the hub knows it (03's ids, 04's level). A hub call the shell makes and passes in (Q-08.6, notes/2026-11-01-wc-16.md section 4); never a surface route, never an access decision in the browser. The chrome and the module use it for what they show and say: the identity line, the composer's wording, the storage namespace (stage B).

user.description: The signed-in user (03 C-03.1 `user`; one person under R16).

display_name.description: The name the hub shows for the user, as the shell shows it. Optional.

session.description: The credential instance behind this view: the user session (ses_) in stage B, the frame's surface session (srf_) in stage A (03 C-03.5, C-03.10).

level.description: The daemon level the hub decided for this user on this chat (04 C-04.4), as the relay stamps it in X-WC-Level. Informative: the daemon and the relay enforce it.

grants.description: The levels held and the true specifics, as X-WC-Grants carries them (04 C-04.9). Optional, informative.

name.description: The machine's display name, as the shell shows it beside the chat.

origins.description: The origins the hub minted for the chat (06-chat-assignment.json origins), so the module needs no derivation.

version.description: The hub's own release, for the identity line and for 12's skew wording.

agent.description: The agent session the hub knows for this chat (06-chat-status.json session), when it has one. Optional, informative.
